name: Female infertility due to an implantation defect of genetic origin
aliases: Genetic implantation failure causing female infertility

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Genetic Implantation Defect Infertility Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Failure to conceive after 12 months of regular unprotected intercourse
Documented recurrent implantation failure confirmed by assisted reproductive technology cycles
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes implicated in endometrial receptivity or embryo implantation
Exclusion of other causes of infertility including tubal, ovulatory, and male factor infertility

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of infertility for at least 12 months, documented recurrent implantation failure, and identification of pathogenic genetic variants affecting implantation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires multidisciplinary evaluation including reproductive endocrinology, genetics, and assisted reproduction specialists.

pathognomonic.notes: Defined as failure to achieve clinical pregnancy after multiple embryo transfers
searchTerms: failure to achieve pregnancy after embryo transfer

common.notes: Abnormal endometrial histology or molecular markers
searchTerms: problems with uterine lining accepting embryo
uterus lining not ready for implantation
implantation failure due to hormonal imbalance

common.symptomName: Elevated uterine natural killer (uNK) cell activity
searchTerms: high activity of uterine natural killer cells
elevated uNK cell levels affecting implantation

occasional.symptomName: Mild pelvic discomfort during implantation window
searchTerms: mild pelvic pain during implantation time
low pelvic ache during implantation window
changed immune signaling in uterine lining
immune profile changes in uterus lining
low ovarian reserve with fertility issues
decreased number of eggs affecting fertility
abnormal blood flow in uterine arteries

laboratory: Genetic testing revealing mutations in implantation-related genes (e.g., LIF, HOXA10, integrins)
Hormonal assays showing luteal phase defects
Elevated uterine natural killer cell counts
imaging: Transvaginal ultrasound showing normal uterine anatomy
Doppler ultrasound indicating altered uterine blood flow
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes regulating endometrial receptivity and embryo implantation
other: Histological evidence of impaired endometrial decidualization
Molecular markers of impaired implantation window

redFlags: Complete absence of implantation despite good quality embryos
Identification of pathogenic genetic variants affecting implantation
